title: Activation Progression Lattice & Owner Inventory
summary: A lightweight, progressive readiness lattice that maps KPI thresholds to activation gates, owners, and sprint workstreams. Designed for short-burst launches (pilot -> staged -> broad) where metric triggers and owner handoffs must be explicit.
body:
Purpose:
This sheet is intended to be used by product-ops and cross-functional launch leads to:
- Define metric thresholds per activation phase (pilot, staged, broad).
- Assign clear owners for each metric and mitigation action.
- Tie sprint workitems to gate pass/fail criteria.
- Provide a concise on-call / escalation roster and 'stop the line' checklist.

How to use: quick steps
1) Populate Current Value column during preflight (48h, 12h, T-0).
2) Flag rows where Current Value is below the Phase Target; owners must propose a short remediation plan (two lines).
3) For any gate with >2 failing critical metrics, trigger roll-back or slow-roll as per the 'activation decision rules' (see linked artifacts).
4) Update this document at each daily ops sync; snapshot and attach to the launch runbook.

Lattice table (plaintext rows - copy into tracker spreadsheet):
Metric | Phase | Phase Target | Current Value | SLA Tier | Owner | Primary Action | Escalation (who) | Sprint Ticket
Activation success rate (first 1000 requests) | pilot -> staged | >= 98% | 96.3% | P0 | Marcus Liu | investigate timeout tail / add circuit breaker | Evan Chen | PRODOPS-9001
Median generation latency (p50) | pilot -> staged -> broad | <= 220ms | 210ms | P1 | Aisha Patel | tune batching policy; validate quantization profile | Nora Svensson | PRODOPS-9002
95th percentile latency (p95) | pilot -> staged | <= 650ms | 720ms | P0 | Marcus Liu | enable reduced-batch fast-path for 95th pct | SRE-Oncall | PRODOPS-9003
Per-call cost (USD per 1k tokens) | staged -> broad | <= $2.15 | $2.45 | P2 | Product Finance | apply caching and request-coalescing | Finance lead | PRODOPS-9004
Embedding quality (NDCG@10 vs baseline) | pilot -> staged | >= 0.92 | 0.94 | P1 | Search Team | rollout model-v2 small, run A/B checks | Research-Lead | PRODOPS-9005
Error rate (500s / total calls) | pilot -> staged -> broad | <= 0.2% | 0.12% | P0 | SRE | investigate regression in model adapter | SRE Manager | PRODOPS-9006
Data leak / PII alerts | pilot -> broad | 0 alerts | 1 alert | P0 | Security | pause traffic to private deploy; run content audit | CISO | SEC-1082
Retention of prompt evals (snapshot coverage) | pilot | 100% | 88% | P2 | Aisha Patel | ensure eval ingestion pipeline backfill | Data Eng | PRODOPS-9007

Activation decision rules (condensed):
- Soft-pass: all P1/P2 metrics meet targets; <=1 P0 metric slightly below target (owner remediation accepted). Proceed to next phase with monitoring.
- Hold: any single P0 metric more than 20% off target OR >2 P1 metrics off-target. Pause ramp, run mitigation sprint (48–72h).
- Abort/rollback: critical security/PII alerts OR sustained P95 latency > 2x target for >30 minutes.

Stop-the-line checklist (team-run procedure):
- Who calls it: ops lead or SRE on-call.
- Immediate actions: set traffic to 10% of planned; flip canary to fallback model; notify product, eng, security.
- Communication channels: #launch-ops, escalation page https://confluence.redwood.ai/PRODOPS-ACT-LATTICE-21/comms
- Follow-ups: post-mortem owner assignment within 24h; remediation owner and estimated ETA; release hold lifted only after documented verification run.

Sprint workstream mapping (example short-burst backlog):
- Sprint 1 (week 0): preflight automation (smoke tests + alerting), owner: Marcus Liu, tickets: PRODOPS-9010, PRODOPS-9011
- Sprint 2 (week 1): latency mitigations (batch policy opt + quantization smoke), owner: Aisha Patel, tickets: PRODOPS-9020
- Sprint 3 (week 2): resiliency (fallback model wiring + KV cache warmup), owner: Nora Svensson, tickets: PRODOPS-9034
- On-call rotations: week-of-launch rota published to /sre/rotas; primary SRE oncall + product-ops lead for first 72 hours.

Open questions and decision notes (notes to self style):
- Do we require a hard cost cap per org for broad rollout or prefer signal-based throttling? (PD for finance due 2025-10-10).
- Can dedicated customers opt out of the automatic batch fast-path? Need product policy.
- Proposed change: add automated snapshotting of prompt evals at T-30m so we have a 48h rolling window.

Appendix: quick reference links
- Activation lattice engineering design (confluence:PRODOPS-ACT-LATTICE-21)
- Canary runbook (JIRA:PRODOPS-6120)
- Postmortem template (confluence:postmortem-template)

Revision history:
- 2025-10-02 created by Aisha Patel (initial lattice + owner matrix)
- 2025-10-10 added stop-the-line checklist and escalation roster (input from SRE)
- 2025-10-17 updated p95 thresholds and added sprint ticket mapping (post preflight)

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally compact — copy the lattice table into a Google Sheet for live tracking and wire a Zapier/Sheets -> #launch-ops notification for any cell flagged as failing.
